# Uncle Thomas Locksmith

> 24/7 emergency locksmith in Singapore since 1998, led by Uncle Thomas — a US-trained safesmith. Door lockouts, digital lock opening and installation, safe opening, car lockouts, lock and letterbox replacement, islandwide.

- Phone / WhatsApp: 9224 9224 (+6592249224) — 24/7, islandwide Singapore
- Founded: 1998. Lead locksmith: Uncle Thomas (US-trained safesmith), with a small team.
- Verifies proof of residence or ownership before opening any door, car or safe.
- Warranty on every lock replacement and installation, with no expiry date.
- Does NOT offer key duplication or lock repair.
- UEN: 52862311K

## Prices (from)
- Home / office lockout (9am–6pm): S$80
- Lockout after hours, weekends & public holidays: S$120
- Digital lock emergency opening: S$150
- Digital lock installation (labour): S$120
- Car lockout (non-destructive): S$100
- Main door / gate lock replacement (supply + install): S$100
- Letterbox lock replacement: S$60
- Safe opening: Quote on request
